summary: Window crashes when python outputs too much in terminal
description:

Version: 1.48.0 (user setup)

OS: Windows_NT x64 10.0.18363

### Your operating system
Windows 10 Enterprise, version 1909, build 18363.1016

### List of extensions that you have installed
```
cg-cnu.vscode-path-tools
Gimly81.matlab
kriegalex.vscode-cudacpp
ms-python.python
ms-vscode.hexeditor
ms-vscode.powershell
nhoizey.gremlins
stkb.rewrap
tht13.html-preview-vscode
```

It occurs even with all the extensions disabled
### Reproducible steps (1... 2... 3...) that cause the issue
You need python installed (I don't know if it can be reproduced in other ways, but I know that there are no crashes in terminals different from VSCode's one, and that trying to output a huge file with `type` does not provoke the crash)

1. Open the terminal
2. Write `python` to open a python prompt
```
s=11000000*'5'
s
```
3. Click or play a bit with the mouse in the upper section of the window (i.e. not on the terminal)
### What you expected to see, versus what you actually saw
I expect the printing of a very long series of '5''s

What happens is that the window crashes after a while

### Images, animations, or a link to a video showing the issue occurring
[link to a video](https://streamable.com/f27585). 

### Errors from the Dev Tools Console (open from the menu: Help > Toggle Developer Tools)
<s>No error there</s>

EDIT: actually if the Dev Tools are open it pauses with the writing "Paused before potential out-of-memory crash"
